The campaign reaches its end having spent more Western ██████ lives than the historical record: the price of the bolder, more ██████████ road at several of this campaign's genuine forks. The February 1945 eastern-city █████ were declined: Dresden never becomes the word it became, and the oil and rail campaigns finished the war's ██████████ without it, exactly as their own advocates' logic implied they could. Coalition Cohesion held solid across the war's hardest disagreements: the Western partnership that would anchor NATO within a few years was, on this path, unusually strong from the very start. The Strait of Messina was sealed rather than left to the Patton–Montgomery race: denying Kesselring's Italian defense some of the roughly 100,000 veteran troops it historically escaped with.
